$comment: Analyst output for client-issues: issues of concern extracted from a single source file. Collected across parallel shards, then challenged by skeptics.
title: CandidatesResult

candidates.$comment: Zero or more candidate issues from this shard only. Cap keeps parallel challenge cost bounded.

items.$comment: One candidate issue. id must stay stable into the verdict stage so zip_filter can pair left/right.

id.$comment: Stable identifier, e.g. {shardIndex}-{short-slug}. Returned unchanged by the skeptic verdict schema.

kind.$comment: Coarse category label (risk, obligation, inconsistency, open question, …). Free string for demo flexibility.

statement.$comment: The issue claim in plain language—what a human would put in a findings list.

evidence.$comment: Supporting excerpts. Prefer multiple items when several sources back the same claim. Locator lives on each item as source (path, URL, or other ref)—no redundant top-level path field on the candidate.

items.$comment: One citation: where it came from + what it said.

source.$comment: Locator for the quote: file path today; may be a URL or other reference later.
source.description: Where the quote came from (path, URL, or other locator)

quote.$comment: Verbatim or near-verbatim excerpt that supports the statement.

confidence.$comment: Optional self-rated confidence (e.g. high/medium/low). Not required; skeptics should not treat it as proof.
